name: nabungbego
description: Kaya, a calm personal finance tracker. frontend/ is what you see, backend/ saves your data.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
